_comment: The body GitHub returns with HTTP 403 when the rate limit is exhausted, per the REST API documentation. Committed as a fixture so the parser has something real to parse; the x-ratelimit-* header names and value formats alongside it were captured from a live `gh api rate_limit --include` on 2026-09-09 (see rate-limit-headers.txt). This is a recorded response SHAPE, not a mock: no test takes a code path believing it reached GitHub when it did not.
message: API rate limit exceeded for user ID 12345. If you reach out to GitHub Support for help, please include the request ID FA8B:E4CE8:6A1DC7:6F0C21:6AA0E5B0.
